# Ninti One

> > Indigenous-owned professional services firm delivering research, consulting, and community development across remote Australia.

Ninti One is an ISO 9001-certified Indigenous consulting organization with offices in Alice Springs and Adelaide, operating through interconnected for-profit, not-for-profit, and charitable entities. The organization serves Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander communities through research, project management, and evidence-based development programs.

## Key Topics
